name: print-social-slide-social-proof-stat-cards-teal-blob
title: Minimal slide with social platform stat cards over a soft blob
whatItIs: A clean presentation slide pairing a short headline and body copy on the left with three floating white stat cards (Facebook, YouTube, Twitter follower counts) laid over a soft teal organic blob shape.
whatItMeans: A single soft gradient blob gives an otherwise flat white slide a focal point and depth, letting small stat cards feel like they're 'floating' with purpose rather than just placed.
techniques: use one large soft organic blob as a background anchor instead of a busy image
float small white data cards partially over the blob edge for layered depth
keep typography strictly left-aligned and minimal so the blob/cards carry the visual interest

vocabulary.definition: an organic, irregularly rounded background shape used to add softness and focal interest
